notes.subject: fiɲɛ-kumaw
notes.rationale: דברי רוח is literally 'words of wind/breath' — empty speech.

notes.subject: ימריצך
notes.gloss: 'what presses/irritates you' — rare verb; rendered 'what drives you' as KJV 'emboldeneth', JPS 'provoketh'.

notes.subject: to the friends
notes.rationale: Second-person questions aimed at one interlocutor speaking for the group.

notes.subject: questions
notes.rationale: Two rhetorical questions draw the addressee in and press the point.

translation: Yala fiɲɛ-kumaw bɛna ban wa? Walima mun de b'i bɔ ⟨i yɛrɛ⟩ la i ka jaabi di?
